html: V. ערב (√ of foll.; cf. Assyrian erêbu, enter, go in; erêb šamši, sunset; Arabic غَرَبَ set (distinct from غَرَبَ depart, = Sab. עֿרב withdraw, according to DHMEpigr. Denkm. 27), غَرْبٌ place of sunset, west; Sab. מערבם, מערבי [not עֿ !] west, western, CISiv. p. 199 DHMl.c.; Ethiopic ዐርበ set (of heavenly bodies), so Syriac ܥܪܶܒ; ܥܪܽܘܒܬܳܐ evening (LagBN 64 f.); Zinj. מערב west; NH עֶרֶב = BH. Hence also Εὐρώπη, Europe, LewyFremdw. 139).
